items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Yeah, Lee Collins, he used to play wrestling.

ctx.x: Well, there were a couple of other trumpet players on the front of my mind. Joe Johnson, do you remember him on the trumpet from uptown? Lee Collins used to tell me about it.
Yeah, Lee Collins, he used to play wrestling. He'd go to sleep on Coley. Yeah, Joe Johnson played trumpets up there.
Do you remember Joe Johnson, what he played like, or what style?
